say.name: Rhea
say.text: So you signed. Good. Before Mira sends you out, I want to see you hold a sword. Hit me. Light and quick: the left button.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: Now put your weight into it. The right button: a heavy blow.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: My turn. Hold the wheel and take my blows on your guard. A guard costs stamina, so watch the green bar.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: When I lift the blade high, the ground goes red. Don't block that one. Wait for it, and dash the moment it falls. Too soon and it finds you anyway.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: Last one. Run, and press Ctrl to slide. Low and fast, under a swing or out of a crowd.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: That will keep you alive out there. Go on. Mira has work for you.
